exam.title: Operationalizing Machine Learning and Generative AI Solutions
exam.study_prerequisites: Python, machine learning, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, GitHub Actions, Azure CLI, Bicep, CI/CD, evaluation, monitoring, RAG and fine-tuning fundamentals.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Design and implement an MLOps infrastructure
Implement machine learning model lifecycle and operations
Design and implement a GenAIOps infrastructure
Implement generative AI quality assurance and observability
Optimize generative AI systems and model performance

review.notes: Every official subobjective is mapped to infrastructure, reproducibility, lifecycle, deployment, monitoring, evaluation, optimization and failure evidence. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 checks cover Azure ML MLOps plus Microsoft Foundry GenAIOps. All 41 URLs are cataloged: 39 reachable and two commercial pages blocked; none broken. No upcoming exam change or retirement was announced.

findings.title: Legacy ML toolchain support ended
findings.evidence: CLI v1 ended September 2025 and SDK v1 June 2026.
findings.recommendation: Add package/extension migration boundary without claiming service shutdown.
findings.resolution: Add package/extension migration boundary without claiming service shutdown.

findings.title: Current course outline/runtime is not exposed
findings.evidence: Four days/twelve languages visible; prior paths/duration not reproduced.
findings.recommendation: Replace current-total claim with editorial estimate and separate exam language.
findings.resolution: Replace current-total claim with editorial estimate and separate exam language.

findings.title: Pipeline reuse has more inputs than code and data
findings.evidence: Determinism, force rerun, snapshots, environment and runtime/output settings govern reuse.
findings.recommendation: Add diagnostic contract and mutable-reference warning.
findings.resolution: Add diagnostic contract and mutable-reference warning.

findings.title: Feature contract requires point-in-time lineage
findings.evidence: Specification references registered features and training observation time.
findings.recommendation: Add packaging explanation and future/late-arrival example.
findings.resolution: Add packaging explanation and future/late-arrival example.

findings.title: Responsible AI dashboard is not universal model support
findings.evidence: Tabular/sklearn/MLflow and dataset limits; AutoML exclusions.
findings.recommendation: Scope dashboard guidance and keep independent responsible evaluation.
findings.resolution: Scope dashboard guidance and keep independent responsible evaluation.

findings.title: Mirroring copies execution without routing user responses
findings.evidence: Single target up to 50%, managed endpoints; Kubernetes excluded.
findings.recommendation: Add capacity/effect distinction and shadow-versus-canary example.
findings.resolution: Add capacity/effect distinction and shadow-versus-canary example.

findings.title: Monitoring needs collection and mature labels
findings.evidence: Batch/external data collection owned by customer; windows and label delay matter.
findings.recommendation: Add collection, window, coverage and subgroup example.
findings.resolution: Add collection, window, coverage and subgroup example.

findings.title: Managed network choices are not freely reversible
findings.evidence: Agent outbound isolation has provisioning/region, approval and transition constraints.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped modes, creation requirements and denied-egress evidence.
findings.resolution: Add scoped modes, creation requirements and denied-egress evidence.

findings.title: PTU planning depends on cache and model parameters
findings.evidence: Normalized input/output capacity, supported increments and demand shape.
findings.recommendation: Add fictional sizing/cache-loss example and benchmarking boundary.
findings.resolution: Add fictional sizing/cache-loss example and benchmarking boundary.

findings.title: Quota and reservation do not hold model capacity
findings.evidence: Allocation and billing discount differ from deployable capacity.
findings.recommendation: Separate planning decisions and verification requirement.
findings.resolution: Separate planning decisions and verification requirement.

findings.title: Provisioned spillover is not arbitrary model fallback
findings.evidence: Same model/version/resource and settings precedence; target can fail.
findings.recommendation: Add response attribution, residency and usage checks.
findings.resolution: Add response attribution, residency and usage checks.

findings.title: Hosted rollback and fine-tuning have distinct lifecycle constraints
findings.evidence: Provisioned migration manual; training/deployment retire separately.
findings.recommendation: Require available compatible rollback bundle and dated model/SKU review.
findings.resolution: Require available compatible rollback bundle and dated model/SKU review.

findings.title: Evaluation SDK and scenario contracts evolved
findings.evidence: Current project setup uses >=2.2.0 and project OpenAI client.
findings.recommendation: Add pinned-environment, roles and scenario distinctions.
findings.resolution: Add pinned-environment, roles and scenario distinctions.

findings.title: Missing trace content can produce no quality score
findings.evidence: Eligible invoke_agent/message attributes required; no original request replay.
findings.recommendation: Add content/privacy boundary, sample bias and fail-closed coverage gate.
findings.resolution: Add content/privacy boundary, sample bias and fail-closed coverage gate.

findings.title: Broad observability GA does not imply every monitor feature GA
findings.evidence: Current settings marked preview and require log access.
findings.recommendation: Add feature-level status and protected-table permission scope.
findings.resolution: Add feature-level status and protected-table permission scope.

findings.title: Hybrid score is not a cosine or reranker score
findings.evidence: RRF depends on rank/list count; reranker score separate.
findings.recommendation: Add original rank-fusion calculation and threshold warning.
findings.resolution: Add original rank-fusion calculation and threshold warning.

findings.title: Customization method and access differ by model
findings.evidence: SFT/DPO/RFT and gated RFT support; minimum examples not quality guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Add method/signal/check matrix and eligibility boundary.
findings.resolution: Add method/signal/check matrix and eligibility boundary.

findings.title: Written policy needs execution-point controls and tests
findings.evidence: Policy evaluation and control checkpoints have distinct responsibilities.
findings.recommendation: Add original authorization fixtures and probabilistic-classifier limitation.
findings.resolution: Add original authorization fixtures and probabilistic-classifier limitation.

offline_checks: 27 assertions covering point-in-time selection, shadow load, label coverage, PTU/cache arithmetic, fail-closed evaluation, RRF and catalog totals; one local gate executed, one YAML fragment parsed.

limitations: No cloud, SDK, API, ML job, model, dataset upload, managed network, endpoint, traffic shift, fine-tuning, telemetry query, capacity reservation, purchase or paid-course execution.
Synthetic examples and local gate do not prove deployed permissions, concurrent effects, representative quality, sampling validity, capacity, pricing or service availability.
Direct Udemy blocked and Whizlabs/assessment shells limited; indexed metadata does not verify content quality, question originality, difficulty or coverage. Provider searches bounded.

Learn path/runtime total unavailable; OReilly linked event historical and recording unverified. Only noted sections of long product references/blogs read; general retained references refreshed without exhaustive reread.
Feature/region/model/SDK support and preview status require rechecking for the actual environment. No complete per-model retirement or capacity table audit.
Same-context AI research and repair; independent human review pending.

validation.execution_boundary: Local validation only; no infrastructure lab executed.
